e.g. e-stop + gate, 3 NO safety contacts
Reset accepted only if -K1 and -K2 are released (mirror contacts closed); start on the falling edge of -S6.
Several e-stops in series on one relay → fault masking possible (ISO/TR 24119) → typically max. PL d. Safety PLC: one input pair per button.
